claims.title: Actual globalization obstruction
claims.printed_hypotheses_tex: Commutative-ring modules and a linear presentation $G\xrightarrow{A}V\xrightarrow{\delta}W$ with $\delta A=0$; a compatible vector $v\in\ker\delta$.

claims.title: The all-future invisible quotient
claims.printed_hypotheses_tex: Commutative-ring modules; a linear observation $O:X\to Y$ and an arbitrary family of allowed endomorphisms $T_i:X\to X$; every finite chronological word is included.

claims.title: Exact hidden elimination

claims.title: Realizable finite observation tables
